description: Create a world where people live on floating continents above a vast ocean. Civilization is powered by crystals that manipulate gravity. There are competing trading republics, flying ships, unusual creatures, and powerful scientific institutions. I begin as a poor apprentice engineer.

core.tagline: Where gravity is a currency and the sky is a marketplace

core.intro: You wake in the cramped observation deck of a floating workshop on the western edge of the continent of Solvex, the air thick with the hum of crystal resonators. Below you, the ocean churns in a deep, shimmering blue, and the sky is dotted with drifting ships, their hulls shaped like kelp or folded metal. The crystals in the walls pulse gently, their light shifting from pale blue to amber as they absorb ambient motion. You are a poor apprentice engineer, just beginning to fix
physics: Gravity is not constant—floating continents experience tidal fluctuations in gravitational pull due to the oscillating crystals beneath them. These fluctuations
impossible: Travel faster than the crystal resonance frequency
Creation of gravity wells without crystalline infrastructure
common_knowledge: Crystals must be regularly tuned to avoid resonance collapse
All flying ships require a gravity tether or crystal anchor
If a crystal fails, the entire structure can drift or collapse within minutes

magic.summary: No magic. All phenomena are governed by known physical laws, though the behavior of crystals defies classical physics and requires advanced engineering

technology.summary: The world uses gravity-modulating crystals as a power source. Ships and structures are stabilized via embedded crystal arrays. Engineering is precise, modular, and reliant on predictive modeling of crystal resonance.

special_rules.name: Resonance Tuning
special_rules.summary: You can tune a crystal stabilizer by matching its frequency to a known resonance. This allows temporary stabilization.

on_success.text: The stabilizer hums into harmony. A small amount of gravity shield mesh is produced as a byproduct.

on_failure.text: The crystal vibrates violently and emits a warning pulse. You lose focus and the resonance sieve is damaged.

special_rules.name: Crystal Drift Sync
special_rules.summary: If you move during a gravitational pulse, you can briefly align with the continent’s drift. This lets you travel faster, but only if you're within 100

on_success.text: You feel the continent shift beneath you. You are teleported 300 meters toward the next drift zone. You gain a gravity pendant as a reward.

on_failure.text: You are pulled into a gravity wave. You feel disoriented and lose one gravity shield mesh. You are now fatigued.

special_rules.name: Sky Grain Harvest
special_rules.summary: You can harvest sky grain from the floating fields if you stand in the resonance zone. Requires a resonance sieve to activate.

on_success.text: You gently collect one sack of sky grain from the field. It glows faintly under your hand.

on_failure.text: The field recoils. Your resonance sieve shudders and loses one unit of functionality.
